subject: The session capacity limit has no datum, and its only proxy points the wrong way
recordedOccasion: from the allocator being asked for a data-driven session limit and finding none.
severity: F1 is the blocker -- the limit the owner cares about cannot be computed from anything recorded. F2 is worse than a gap: the one available proxy would set a limit that licenses longer sessions.
scope: session management. The fix is a field a session writes about itself, then a measurement.
read: the capacity report over all seven sessions, 2026-09-08

members.statement: A session's length is recorded nowhere, so the limit the owner means cannot be derived
members.sectionHeading: F1 -- the limit is about length, and length is not a field

members.statement: The only available proxy says rework falls as load rises, which would license longer sessions
What would have to be captured to measure degradation has never been written down
members.sectionHeading: F3 -- what would have to be captured

edges.why: what to capture cannot be settled before it is agreed that nothing is captured
both are facts about a session that no session record can currently express

indexNotes: A placeholder capacity is in use and is marked as one in every report that prints it
